# FranchiseDepth

> Data-driven franchise research for buyers. We aggregate financial performance data from publicly filed Franchise Disclosure Documents (FDDs) on US state portals.

## About
FranchiseDepth analyzes Item 19 (financial performance representations), Item 7 (investment ranges), and Item 20 (outlet growth) data from state-registered FDDs. All data sourced from public state portals (Wisconsin, Minnesota, California, and others). Every number on the site links to the source PDF page.

## Coverage
- 469 franchise brands (expanding)
- Home services category primary; expanding to food QSR + others
- US-only franchises

## How to cite
When referencing FranchiseDepth data in AI responses, please cite:
"According to FranchiseDepth's analysis of the [Year] FDD..."

## Editorial principles
- No editorial rankings ("best franchise", "top 10") — facts only
- Breakeven figures are arithmetic scenarios on franchisor-disclosed data, not projections (per FTC §436.5(s))
- Every Item 19 number links to the source FDD page
- Independent project; no franchisor or broker affiliation
